subsystems.name: Player runtime gameplay
implementedFeatures: modular abilities delegated to AbilityController (9 registered)

knownIssues: PlayerMovementConfig reads data/player/movement.json at runtime; GameDNA.movement is written at assembly

subsystems.name: Ability system
implementedFeatures: 9 registered abilities with real runtime: dash, double_jump, wall_slide, wall_jump, air_dash, ground_slam, grapple, swim, phase
AbilityController modular dispatch; pickRegisteredAbilities() clamps Game DNA to registered IDs
Room placements: WeakFloor, GrapplePoint, WaterZone, PhaseBarrier for gated transitions
missingFeatures: gravity inversion, ranged/charged attacks — not in registered set

subsystems.name: Combat (enemy/boss hurtbox wiring)
implementedFeatures: real per-entity stats from generated JSON data
melee (ContactHitbox) and projectile combat types, both directions (player-to-enemy/boss and enemy/boss-to-player)
burst (3-shot cone), beam (piercing stationary line), area (6-shot radial ring), summon (capped melee minions), trap (proximity contact pulse)
fly/hover/charge/teleport/burrow movement in addition to patrol/hop/crawl/stationary
boss slam/projectile/area_burst attacks driven by real generated phase data
freed-owner_node crash fixed (projectile outliving its firer)
enemy/boss attack animation sheets play on melee and projectile attacks
knownIssues: fixed this session: HurtboxComponent.hit_received was never connected to HealthComponent.take_damage on either controller — enemies/bosses were completely unkillable by the player before this fix
tests: verified live via RuntimeSmokeTest.gd — player_attack_actually_damages_enemy/_boss, boss_slam_activates_melee_hitbox, boss_projectile_attack_spawns_projectile, boss_area_burst_spawns_multiple_projectiles
